name: Bloodmaster's Ring
summary: You have angered Chub'chob in Bolder'ok's Bloodmaster's Ring. The arena's fee offers no protection from death, and you are left to face him alone.

sections.title: The Arena's Challenge
sections.body: The warning comes after your bouts in Bolder'ok's Bloodmaster's Ring, where you have already drawn Chub'chob's ire. The attendant reminds you that the entry fee will not cover an accidental death. From here, you face Chub'chob, Bloodmaster of Bolder'ok, alone.

sections.title: A New Standing
sections.body: When you return to Clugfist, you bring word that you have become champion of the Bloodmaster's Ring. Your victory earns you a new friend among the clan. You can now fight and feast with the ogres.

faq.answer: Chub'chob is the Bloodmaster of Bolder'ok, and you have angered him in the ring.
The Bloodmaster's Ring is at Bolder'ok.

faq.q: Who do I tell about becoming champion?
faq.answer: You share the news that you have become champion of the Bloodmaster's Ring with Clugfist at Bolder'ok.

faq.q: Does the entry fee cover accidental death?
faq.answer: No. The attendant warns that the entry fee does not cover accidental death.
